name: Sales
description: Sales orders with line discounts and service lines, confirmation, delivery and Thai tax invoices (VAT 7%, amount in Thai words, Buddhist-era date, PromptPay QR) with due dates; receipts (ใบเสร็จรับเงิน) with partial payment, withholding tax and deposits (มัดจำ) with a deposit tax invoice deducted on the final invoice; credit notes (ใบลดหนี้) and debit notes (ใบเพิ่มหนี้) against its own tax invoices, returned goods back into stock; a lock date that follows Accounting's period close; receivables and aging. Cuts stock automatically when Inventory is installed; drafts a sales order from an accepted CRM quotation when CRM is installed.
